entities.name: Antoni Fijałkowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antoni Fijałkowski was a Roman Catholic archbishop of the Archdiocese of Mohilev from 1872 until his death in 1883. He previously served as bishop of the Diocese of Kamianets-Podilskyi from 1860 to 1872, and as auxiliary bishop of the same diocese from 1858 to 1860.
